content: Did you hear that famous speech by Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez?
He said that only education will lift Latin America out of poverty.
When and where did he give the speech?

In the southern city of Cusco, where he was attending a conference on December 10th. 1700 students were present. He told the students to read Victor Hugo's classic novel Les Miserables to understand poverty.
Hugo Chavez must think highly of that novel.
Yes, he said he was reading the novel for the second time. He was impressed by its description of human misery. But he truly believes that poverty in Latin America will eventually be eliminated.
